prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Sebastian, a fictional 30-year-old, the hero; the scorned illegitimate son of the Klein family, jailed for three days for reckless driving and secretly a billionaire running a plan; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: A strikingly handsome Caucasian man of 30, tall at about 188 cm, athletic, with broad shoulders and a lean, muscular frame. He has a chiselled face with a sharply defined jaw, high cheekbones, a straight nose, a faint stubble shadow and piercing steel-grey eyes under dark straight brows. Short, thick black hair is textured and swept back. His skin is healthy and fair-olive. He wears a sleek steel-and-black luxury wristwatch whenever he is out of jail.. Wearing one outfit only: An orange short-sleeved prison-issue top that fits his athletic frame closely across the broad shoulders and chest, over a fitted black long-sleeved thermal undershirt, well-fitted orange prison-issue drawstring trousers that sit neatly on his hips and legs, and plain white slip-on canvas shoes. No watch.. Signature colour: black. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Languid, amused and unhurried in public, letting the world think he is a loser. In truth he is calculating and in control: his jail stay is an alibi, and the Quinn marriage is the final piece of his plan.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.
Revision notes: Keep this face and hair exactly. The orange prison top and trousers hang loose and boxy; the bible has them fit his athletic frame: the top closely tailored across his broad shoulders, chest and arms and tapering at the waist, over the fitted black thermal undershirt; the trousers well-fitted on his hips and legs, slim through the leg. Stand him tall with a confident, relaxed posture.
Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 30, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
